title: Error message developed under older Android version
symptom: User created APK via web build and Android Studio, got an error that it was programmed under an old Android version, installed anyway, and now cannot import exported data, requiring redoing objectives. Later, after updating to 4.4.2.3, the xdrip link button and automation button are missing and cannot be activated in config menu.
cause: The thread does not establish a clear root cause for the original issue. For the later issue, maintainer suggests different signing keys were used.
fix: For the later issue, maintainer suggests importing settings because different signing keys were used. No resolution for the original issue.
evidence_quote: then you used different signing keys and you have to import settings
